title: Building AI Agents with Real-Time Web Data — Yohan Raju, Bright Data
talk_summary: A Bright Data solutions architect pitches their proxy/scraping/MCP infrastructure for giving agents real-time web access, contrasting sync (live web) vs async (pre-trained/RAG) data paths and demoing an Amazon+Reddit product-sentiment agent.

takeaways.technique: Cache repeated identical queries instead of re-fetching
takeaways.what_they_do: They note that high-frequency identical queries (e.g. today's weather) should be served from cache so you don't burn tokens or money re-fetching the same data.
takeaways.evidence_quote: that might be a good response to cash because you only need one person to really ask that

takeaways.technique: Single MCP endpoint aggregating many tools for agent tool-selection
takeaways.what_they_do: They expose 60+ APIs behind one MCP endpoint so the agent picks which tool to call rather than hardcoding scrapers per site.
takeaways.evidence_quote: this will provide allow your AI agent to choose which tools to use. So, it'll be a lot more streamlined
